mapper.sql: v.id, v.product_id, p.sku AS product_sku, p.name AS product_name, v.vin, v.color, v.configuration, v.location, v.status, v.hold_type, v.source_type, v.source_id, v.hold_until, v.create_time, v.create_by, v.update_time, v.update_by
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_product_vehicle v LEFT JOIN t_product p ON v.product_id = p.id WHERE v.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM t_product_vehicle v LEFT JOIN t_product p ON v.product_id = p.id WHERE v.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM t_product_vehicle v LEFT JOIN t_product p ON v.product_id = p.id WHERE v.vin = #{vin}

SELECT FROM t_product_vehicle v LEFT JOIN t_product p ON v.product_id = p.id WHERE v.source_type = #{sourceType} AND v.source_id = #{sourceId} AND v.status IN ('TEST_DRIVE_RESERVED', 'SALES_LOCKED', 'ORDER_RESERVED') ORDER BY v.update_time DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_product_vehicle SET status = #{status}, hold_type = #{holdType}, source_type = #{sourceType}, source_id = #{sourceId}, hold_until = #{holdUntil}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'AVAILABLE'
